findings.description: The Lambda function embeds an AWS access key (AKIA...) and secret key in plain text in the environment variables. These credentials are committed to source control and readable by anyone with describe permissions on the function, so they must be treated as compromised; credentials should be referenced from a secret store (e.g., AWS Secrets Manager / KMS) instead.

The function uses runtime nodejs12.x, which is end-of-life and no longer receives security patches while continuing to execute, exposing the workload to known unpatched vulnerabilities. It should be migrated to a supported runtime version.
